description: Ministry of Megapolis & Wetern Development -  Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition of land in Aluth Mawatha, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels being acquired by the government, including location details (province, district, village), plot numbers, extents, and compensation deposit information. The notice specifically deals with the legal process of land acquisition and compensation payment, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
